ideas.title: Farm for Bail 🌾
ideas.hook: You're locked up, but the prison yard has dirt. Grow veggies in your cell-block plot, sell them to the guards' canteen and save up enough to pay your own bail.
core_loop: Plant seeds in your yard plot
Water and guard crops between roll calls
Sell the harvest to the canteen for cash
Pay down your bail meter and unlock better plots
Post bail to rebirth into a tougher prison with rarer seeds
ideas.twist: Random cell inspections: guards confiscate anything growing outside your plot, so players hide rare crops in laundry carts and under bunks.
monetization: VIP yard with a golden greenhouse
retention: Daily seed drop at the commissary
ideas.why_now: Prison / police jumped 0.54 this week to 1.46 momentum (Tesla Roadster Chase 9,746 CCU at 14 days, Punch Out Of Prison 5,811). Grow / farm is up 0.29 to 1.39 with 35 new games (high confidence; Durian Garden 7,231 at 14 days, Farm Evolution 6,974).
ideas.differentiator: Farming games are cosy. Here the farm is a jailbreak by paperwork, and inspections add a hide-and-seek layer.

ideas.title: Sketch the Crook ✏️
ideas.hook: A robber flashes past for five seconds. The witness picks clues, the artists draw the face, and the detectives have to pick the right crook out of a police lineup using only those drawings.
core_loop: One player is the witness and sees the crook
Witness taps clue cards (hat, scar, hair colour)
Artists draw the suspect in 45 seconds
Detectives pick from a 10-NPC lineup
Points for correct picks; best sketch wins a badge
ideas.twist: The crook is a real player hiding in the lineup who can swap one accessory before the vote.
monetization: VIP brush and colour pack (~99 R$)
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 2.06 momentum with 19 new games, spread out (high confidence; Paint and Hide! 12,050 CCU, Make a Cartoon! 8,751). Prison / police rose 0.54 this week to 1.46. Interiors are the hottest map style at 1.93.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing party games ask you to copy a prompt. Here the drawing is evidence, and a live player is trying to fool it.

ideas.title: Ice Cube Escape 🧊
ideas.hook: You're an ice cube that fell out of the freezer into a blazing hot kitchen. You melt every second, so slide past stoves and toasters to reach the freezer at the far end.
core_loop: Spawn as a full-size ice cube
Slide through kitchen stages while you shrink
Touch frost pads for +1 size
Reach checkpoints before you melt to nothing
Spend frost on bigger starting size and faster slides
ideas.twist: Being small is also useful: tiny cubes fit through vents and cracks that big cubes can't, so you sometimes want to melt on purpose.
monetization: +1 Size per frost multiplier pass (~199 R$)
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is up 0.52 this week to 1.60 with 34 new games (high; +1 Spider Arm 16,358 CCU, 30 Floors Up 5,971). Ice / fire rose 0.29 to 1.48 (Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] 6,977). Interiors (1.93) and linear courses (1.80) are the top map styles.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 escapes only grow you. Here size is a timer and a key at once, so shrinking is part of the route.

ideas.title: Plant a Robot 🤖
ideas.hook: Bury a bolt, water it with oil and a little robot sprouts out of the ground. Grow a whole field of bots that harvest, sort and guard your farm for you.
core_loop: Plant bolt seeds in your plot
Oil them until robots pop out
Robots auto-harvest more bolts
Fill the 40-robot index
Fuse rare bots into a giant farm mech
ideas.twist: Lightning storms mutate whatever is growing, so players rush to plant their best seeds right before a storm hits.
ideas.why_now: Robots / mechs is at 2.01 momentum with 11 new games (high; Steel Fighters 10,407 CCU, Clean the Moon! 7,265). Grow / farm is up 0.29 this week to 1.39 with 35 new games (Durian Garden 7,231).
ideas.differentiator: Robot games are about building or fighting. Here you grow them like crops and they become your farm hands.

ideas.title: Don't Get Boxed 📦
ideas.hook: You're a toy robot on a factory conveyor heading straight for the packing machine. Run back up the line, grab spare parts and bolt them on before the box closes.
core_loop: Start at the end of the conveyor
Run against the belt past stamps and claws
Grab parts for +1 speed, jump or grip
Reach a stage door before the belt drags you back
Keep parts and push further next run
ideas.twist: Parts change your shape: wheels are fast but can't jump, springs jump high but slip, so your build decides your route.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is up 0.52 this week to 1.60 (high; Steal A Pet And Ride It! 27,655 CCU, +1 Spider Arm 16,358). Robots / mechs sits at 2.01 with 11 new games. +1 stat per action is at 1.99 with 37 new games (+1 Venom Evolution 22,996).
ideas.differentiator: Escape games give you a speed stat. Here every upgrade is a visible body part that changes how you move.

ideas.title: Hire a Zombie Crew 🧟
ideas.hook: Zombies work for free, but they are terrible at it. Hire them from the graveyard to run your candy factory and keep them on task before they shuffle off.
core_loop: Hire zombies at the graveyard
Assign them to machines in your factory
Keep them focused with music and snacks
Sell candy for cash and expand the factory
Collect rare zombie workers with special skills
ideas.twist: Zombies follow the nearest player, so friends can lure your crew away to their own factory unless you guard the doors.
retention: Daily rare hire at the graveyard
ideas.why_now: Zombies are at 1.49 momentum with 10 new games, spread out (high; Ragdoll Reality 14,936 CCU, 30 Floors Up 5,971). Tycoon / base building has 78 new games (high; My Small Business 10,723, Sell a Million Sushi 9,587), though it eased 0.23 this week.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games make you fight or flee. Here they are your clumsy staff, and other players can poach them.

ideas.title: Paint a Decoy 🎨
ideas.hook: The horde is coming. Paint life-size cardboard people as fast as you can and set them out as decoys while your team sneaks to the rescue van.
core_loop: Grab a blank cardboard cut-out
Paint a person on it in 30 seconds
Place it to pull the horde away
Sprint to the van while zombies chase decoys
Earn paint and better boards for the next round
ideas.twist: Zombies judge your art: more detail means they stay on a decoy longer, so a rushed stick figure buys you two seconds.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 2.06 momentum with 19 new games, spread out (high; Paint and Hide! 12,050 CCU). Zombies hold 1.49 with 10 new games (Ragdoll Sandbox 12,494). Escape / run is up 0.52 this week to 1.60.
ideas.differentiator: Paint and Hide paints you. Here you paint fake people, and the quality of your art is your survival time.

ideas.title: +1 Thruster Power 🚀
ideas.hook: You're stuck orbiting a tiny planet. Every lap gives +1 thruster power, and once you're strong enough you blast out of its gravity to the next, bigger planet.
core_loop: Fly laps around the planet
Gain +1 thrust per lap
Try to break orbit
Land on the next planet with stronger gravity
Rebirth for a permanent thrust multiplier
ideas.twist: Asteroids cross your orbit and knock you back down a ring, so you dodge while you grind.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 1.99 momentum with 37 new games (high; +1 Venom Evolution 22,996 CCU, +1 Anime Eyes 17,773). Space sits at 1.51 with 13 new games (medium; Clean the Moon! 7,265, +1 Slinky Escape 801).
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games are a straight track. Here the track is an orbit, and escaping gravity is the level-up.

ideas.title: Jar a Fairy 🧚
ideas.hook: When night falls on the forest, tiny glowing fairies come out. Catch them in jars, line your cottage shelves and light up your home with the rarest ones.
core_loop: Explore the forest at night
Sneak up and jar fairies
Bring them home to light your cottage
Fill the fairy index
Trade rare fairies with friends
ideas.twist: Each fairy only appears in certain weather (rain, fog, full moon), so the server's weather decides who goes hunting.
ideas.why_now: Collect / index is steady at 1.64 with 46 new games (medium; Break and Steal an Egg 126,851 CCU, Bike For Egg! 24,176). Fantasy / medieval is at 1.29 with 14 new games (medium; Tower Of Luck 3,842).
ideas.differentiator: Collect games hatch eggs. Here you hunt in a living night forest, and weather sets what can be found.

ideas.title: Run a Quarry ⛏️
ideas.hook: Blast your own quarry and sell stone to the town next door. The town actually builds itself from your stone, so the more you mine, the bigger it gets.
core_loop: Drill and blast rock walls
Haul stone blocks by cart
Sell to builders for cash
Buy bigger drills and trucks
Watch the town grow from your stone
ideas.twist: Players who sell the most stone get a statue of themselves carved in the town square for the week.
ideas.why_now: Stones / rocks / ores rose 0.25 this week to 1.74 with 14 new games (high; Cut a Rock 15,253 CCU, Punch Out Of Prison 5,811). Tycoon / base building has 78 new games, spread out (high), though it eased 0.23.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games end at a sell button. Here your stone shows up in a shared town and a statue of the top miner.
